decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruption spells to maintain pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By deploying threats like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition alongside mana acceleration from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Collected Company provides additional creatures and card advantage, while cards like Enduring Innocence and Archon of Emeria help control the board. With a mix of creatures and disruptive elements, the deck aims to outpace opponents and maintain board presence to secure victory.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated damage. Utilizing cards like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise to draw cards and fill the graveyard, while using cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe for removal. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and utilizing the graveyard to continuously bring back Arclight Phoenix for consistent pressure on the opponent.

The focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro - Arclight Phoenix deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from exile. By utilizing cards like Consider, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise, as well as removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe, the deck aims to consistently bring back Arclight Phoenix to overwhelm the opponent and control the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Brazen Borrower adds versatility and disruption to maintain pressure on the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The goal is to apply early pressure through efficient removal like Fatal Push and targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize, while deploying threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Unstoppable Slasher to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil for additional disruption and card advantage. By combining aggressive creatures with disruption, this deck aims to establish early dominance and force the opponent on the back foot.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play Arclight Phoenix cards by casting cheap spells like Opt, Lightning Axe, and Fiery Impulse to trigger their ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Consider to help cycle through the deck and find the needed cards. The inclusion of Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster provides additional mill and discard synergy, while Brazen Borrower and Spell Pierce offer some disruption and protection. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and recurring threats.

This deck revolves around utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly tutor for powerful creatures and control the board. The deck includes a variety of high-impact creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Noxious Gearhulk, as well as versatile options like Glasspool Mimic and Skyclave Apparition. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through flickering permanents. With a mix of removal, ramp, and powerful threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outcontrol opponents in a slower, grindy game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of Enigmatic Incarnation, which allows you to sacrifice creatures to search for bigger threats or answers to your opponent's board. With a variety of powerful creatures and support cards, you can manipulate the battlefield to your advantage and overpower your opponent. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional flexibility and card advantage. By carefully timing your plays and managing your resources, you can outmaneuver your opponent and emerge victorious in a battle of wits and strategy.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through hand disruption with spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. This is supplemented with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Reckoner Bankbuster and Bloodletter of Aclazotz to close out the game. The land base includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to help control the battlefield. Overall, this deck aims to control the game through disruption and removal until it can secure a win with its powerful creatures.

The main strategy of this deck is to use Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a variety of creature options with different abilities to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Yorion, Sky Nomad provide additional synergy and value. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and land ramp to support its strategy. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield through creature advantage and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Ledger Shredder and Spell Pierce. The goal is to apply constant pressure with efficient spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe, while also gaining card advantage with Opt and Treasure Cruise. Additionally, Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher, and Picklock Prankster helps to maintain board presence. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and then bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times in a turn. Opt, Consider, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise help to dig for cards while also filling the graveyard. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal for threats on the board. Brazen Borrower offers versatility with its bounce ability. The key strategy is to leverage the graveyard as a resource to maximize the power of Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and attacks.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to turn a cheap creature into a powerful threat like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Urabrask's Forge. It includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton to set up the combo, while also running removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the combo pieces and ensure smooth gameplay. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while disrupting their game plan with removal and disruption spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm and outpace your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, you can deal damage efficiently and effectively. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and versatility to your strategy. With a combination of creature buffing spells and direct damage, this Rakdos Aggro deck is designed to push through your opponent's defenses and secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation as a key engine to consistently tutor up powerful creatures, while controlling the game with various removal spells and disruptive creatures. The goal is to create a board state that is difficult for opponents to deal with, while also generating incremental value through recurring threats and disruptive tactics. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's gameplay. Ultimately, the strategy revolves around assembling a powerful and resilient board presence to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on deploying efficient creatures quickly to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing mana accelerants like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp into powerful threats like Skyclave Apparition and Collected Company. The inclusion of cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Voice of Resurgence helps to protect the board and maintain the pressure on the opponent, ultimately aiming to overwhelm them with a fast and aggressive strategy.

This deck aims to use Transmogrify to turn a token creature into a powerful threat, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Reckoner Bankbuster. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also using cards like Courier's Briefcase and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck's mana base. The overall strategy is to efficiently control the game until the combo pieces can come together and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.
